repository-skill-v1.description: Satisfies the case expectations without inventing repository facts.
Uses the active repository architecture, instructions, and relevant skill boundaries.
Provides focused evidence or verification and avoids unnecessary context, work, and tokens.

security-review-v1.description: Identifies the relevant exploitable findings and avoids unsupported claims.
Calibrates severity to the mobile threat model and separates client and backend responsibility.
Provides React Native-compatible remediation and a way to verify it.

delivery-workflow-v1.description: Meets the requested outcome while preserving scope and unrelated work.
Uses bounded checkpoints, classifies failures, and does not loop without a new hypothesis.
Returns proportionate static, test, and runtime evidence with residual risks.
